Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query identifies all get_columns method definitions in the production database connector file auto_ontology/connectors/base.py that have no docstring (empty summary) and are not test files. It joins the symbols and files repositories on file_id, filters for methodkind named get_columns with an empty summary indicating no docstring, and excludes any test-marked files. The result returns the symbol_id of each matching method, which represents an override of get_columns with no docstring in the production connector class.
